knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The client's injury is a medical question. The instructor refers the client before the first session and records the referral. The instructor does not promise a fix.
A premium price is built from session time, preparation, travel, equipment and compliance costs, not from a health claim.
The lesson says to treat the home as a workplace for set-up and safety, and to check the room before the session.

practicalCriteria: Assessor checks that a simulated private client has a completed questionnaire and a referral record before the first session
Assessor observes the candidate complete a simulated lone-worker check-in at arrival and departure of a home visit
Assessor checks a sample premium price build that includes preparation and travel time
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Health questionnaire and referral record for the simulated private client
Lone-worker check-in record for the simulated home visit
Price build sheet for the sample premium session
stopWorkCriteria: The candidate starts a private session for a client with an unreviewed medical question
The candidate describes a private session as a treatment for a condition
